title: Latency/Cost Stability Scoring and Pin Reconciliation Playbook
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Summary: Create an operational playbook and automated reconciliation flow that decides when a Redwood-verified performance profile should be refreshed, when a model version should be pinned/unpinned, and how to present recommended changes to human reviewers.

Scope:
- Define a composite 'stability score' for verified profiles that combines latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), throughput variance, cost-per-token delta, and synthetic harness pass/fail rates.
- Implement a nightly reconciliation job that scores live profiles, detects drift against published baselines, and generates candidate pin changes (rollforward, rollback, or flag for manual review).
- Add explicit TTL and aging semantics to profiles so older artifacts are marked 'stale' and require re-verification.
- Provide a human-in-the-loop approval UI in Console for high-risk automatic recommendations (customer-facing pins, >10% cost change, or P99 regressions).
- Establish canary thresholds and automated fallback for rollout (sparse canary + 24h observation window).

Out of scope: fully automated pinning without human approval for customer-impacting changes; storage migration for legacy profile artifacts.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Nightly reconciliation job produces digestable change proposals and stores them in staging-bucket with unique change IDs.
2) Stability score defined with weighting doc and reproducible SQL/compute script.
3) Console UI shows proposed pin changes with compare view (latency, cost, throughput), and a one-click approve/reject.
4) Automated rollback policy triggers fallback when canary violates SLOs within the observation window.
5) Documentation and runbook published to Confluence; on-call notified on failures.
notes: 2026-03-10 — Aisha: Initial draft of scoring model and reconciliation flow. Shared with runtime and console eng for feasibility checks.

2026-03-11 — Daniel: Runtime team confirmed we can export daily latency histograms and cost rollups as telemetry; flagged need for downsampled KV cache metrics. Action: ENG to add 2 counters (kv_cache_hit_ratio, avg_batch_size).
2026-03-11 — Priya (Console): UI prototype uploaded to Figma and Confluence; suggested an approval step that records approver and rationale for auditability.
2026-03-12 — Security review note: no secret data in playbook but need to ensure audit log retention for pin approvals (30d). Security asked to review retention policy; assigned to Sam Chen.
2026-03-12 — Decision: Stability score will weight p95 (40%), p99 (25%), cost delta (20%), throughput variance (10%), synthetic harness pass-rate (5%). We will iterate weights after 2-week pilot.

2026-03-12 — Trade-off: Fully automated pin updates reduce ops overhead but increase risk of regressions. We default to 'recommendation' mode; auto-apply only for low-risk background models (no customer pins) after 60-day baseline stability.
